name: Hardened Google Workspace MCP
description: A security-hardened integration that enables Claude to interact with Google Workspace tools like Gmail, Drive, and Docs while preventing data exfiltration by disabling features like email sending and external file sharing. It allows users to safely manage emails, documents, and calendars through natural language without risking unauthorized external communication.
